assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One full-bleed landscape 16:9 game background for a cozy pastel pixel-art virtual pet game. Center foreground clear wooden floor and one pale pink reading mat. Detailed crisp pixel art matching a pink pixel pet bedroom, soft dusty rose and cream palette with scene-appropriate colors, rounded furnishings, warm gentle light, slightly elevated eye-level perspective. Leave lower center uncluttered for a separately composited small pet standing at 75% image height. No pets, people or characters, no text, labels, logos, UI, frames or watermark. Single coherent scene, not a collage.
